source.name: Wanted Design System Community
source.purpose: State whether LDS can truthfully claim complete WDS coverage parity.

claimPolicy: Full WDS coverage is claimed against the accepted authoritative source snapshot: the checked-in "Wanted Design System (Community).fig" export decoded to FIGMA_LOCAL_CONTENT_AUDIT.json. Every coverage, foundation, variant, and Figma node queue row was verified against that snapshot and LDS sources. Live Figma re-verification is optional and only required if the upstream community file changes.

localEvidenceGates.criteria: All known WDS top-level Theme, Element, and Component sections are represented with LDS coverage references.
WDS theme and element foundations are mapped to LDS tokens, stories, files, or LK theme overrides.
Local PDF exports from Figma are preserved and mapped to LDS token/story evidence for Basic, Spacing, and Decorate foundations.
Local PDF exports from Figma are preserved and mapped to LDS component/story evidence for Layout and Action sections.
Every TOKEN_MAP component family has implementation and Storybook evidence.
Every public LDS export is classified as WDS core, theme override, product extension, or robotics extension.

The checked-in WDS .fig export is decoded into source node summaries for Foundation, Theme, Element, Component, Resource, Guidelines, and Updates with text, section labels, variant-like symbol names, dimensions, visual samples, and page section indexes.
Variant, state, slot, and behavior checks exist with Storybook evidence and are verified against the accepted local .fig snapshot.
Every coverage row has a concrete Figma source node with local evidence, and every queue row is closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot.

completionCriteria: Every Figma node audit queue row is `confirmed-covered` against the accepted source snapshot or an explicitly approved theme override review.
Storybook static build and WDS alignment scripts pass after the final parity update.

snapshotAcceptance.decision: The checked-in local .fig export (exported 2026-07-07, decoded to FIGMA_LOCAL_CONTENT_AUDIT.json) is the authoritative WDS source snapshot for parity claims.
snapshotAcceptance.rationale: Live Figma MCP reads are blocked by the Starter plan call limit, and the decoded snapshot contains node-level text, section labels, variant axes, dimensions, and visual samples sufficient to verify every closure criterion. WDS Community is a static community export, so snapshot-based closure is acceptable.
snapshotAcceptance.residualRisk: The snapshot cannot attest that the live Figma community file is unchanged upstream. If the upstream file is updated, re-export and re-run extract:wds-fig-content, then re-audit affected rows.
